messages:
Maya L.: reopening spend layout — during QA the invoice download CTA is getting pushed off-screen on narrow widths. need a decision: where should CTA and scope toggle live so users don't miss invoices?

Josh K.: yep noticed. current mobile stack is chart -> tokens -> actions. users expect invoice/download near the top.

Elaine (Design): uploaded two quick mocks: https://redwood.design/mockups/spend-compact-cta
Proposal A: pin invoice CTA under scope toggle in header.
Proposal B: floating FAB on small screens.

Samir: prefer pinned header for discoverability, but reduce visual weight (outline). use copy "Download invoices" instead of just "Invoice".

Oliver P.: product point: CTA copy should include scope — default org admins see org scope; in project view show "Download project invoices". also add telemetry for clicks.

Elaine (Design): accessibility: aria-label should include scope and org/project name, e.g. "Download invoices for Acme Corp (org)". role=button and visible focus styles.

Maya L.: token visual feedback: users find token bubbles noisy on small screens. suggestion: show compact chips + a toggle to expand to bubble chart.

Josh K.: sounds good. default compact table/chips on narrow widths; bubble chart by default on desktop.

Samir: keep top-3 token types visible when collapsed, support hover/keyboard to expand details. add clear keyboard-focus states.

Elaine (Design): updated mock: chips row + "More" chevron, focus styles included, high-contrast outlines.

design-bot: attachment: screenshot-2039124567-v2.png (uploaded)

Oliver P.: about scope toggle placement — analytics shows top toolbar is used more for quick switching. vote for top so CTA and scope are adjacent.

Maya L.: agree top toolbar. ensure it stays single-line on mobile; use ellipsis for long project names and a kebab for actions.

Josh K.: impl note: header must support position:sticky with z-index over chart. fallback to FAB if sticky isn't available. I'll draft RFC PR.

Samir: A/B experiment plan: A = pinned header CTA + compact tokens default; B = floating FAB + bubble default. metrics: invoice-download, token-expand, scope-switch.

Elaine (Design): will update Figma and handoff. tagging @engineering-design for accessibility review.

Oliver P.: I'll set up the experiment in LaunchDarkly and share the doc. :thumbsup: 

Samir: accessibility follow-up: invoice filename should include org/project and ISO date so screen-reader users can identify it.

Elaine (Design): adding that to spec.

Maya L.: thanks — closing after mocks are pushed and PRs linked.
